name: session-learner
description: Learns lessons when a session is marked done (/done, the completed flag, or the app closing it), saves them to Hindsight and project memory after your review in /learn, and tunes your skills from how they do over time.

showBand.title: Show the band above the prompt
showBand.description: A line above the prompt such as: Learned 3 lessons: 2 saved, 1 to review.

reviewMode.title: Review mode
reviewMode.description: off: nothing runs. suggest: everything waits in /learn. controlled: low-risk lessons apply themselves. advanced: passing skill drafts apply themselves too.

maxModelCalls.title: Max model calls per run
maxModelCalls.description: A run stops when it would make more model calls than this.

maxTokens.title: Max tokens per run
maxTokens.description: A run stops when its model calls would use more tokens than this.

maxChanges.title: Max changes per run
maxChanges.description: The most lessons or skill changes one run applies by itself.

dailySpendUsd.title: Daily spend cap in USD
dailySpendUsd.description: Runs stop calling the model once today's spend reaches this. 0 means no cap.
